ICAR CTCRI Skilled Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Skilled Assistant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Skilled Assistant post at ICAR CTCRI is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Skilled Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma, +2 Vocational, or a Graduate degree in Science to be eligible for the Skilled Assistant post at ICAR CTCRI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Skilled Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Skilled Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 17,000.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Skilled Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Skilled Assistant post is between 18 years and 50 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this ICAR CTCRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Skilled Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Skilled Assistant post at ICAR CTCRI.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Skilled Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Skilled Assistant position will be based on an Interview.
